confirmed: K1 consumed includes mandatory current; consumed_drafts is only 0/1 nonterminal consumed proposals. Both complete checkpoint and repair/catchup branch use consumed_drafts, never first_agrees.

Flash and Pro greedy keep original quota2/empty EOS finite component contract; no claim that the migration adds independent greedy EOS/quota coverage.

Legacy K1Decision, Checkpoint labels, decide_k1 and replacement aliases are absent from GLM source.
